title: wrapped bread with canned corn at before thursday lunch

title: Bitter rain at camp
body: We pitched the tent beyond the trial orchard because they said the fields were the only treated ground. Rain ran down the canvas and left the same yellow dust on our cups. My daughter had not eaten anything from the orchard.
rival_reading: The containment response might explain a contaminated object or warning being displaced.
gloss: A witness records evidence of exposure near treated land.
